name: rentemester-legacy-imported-receivable-backfills-v38
sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS legacy_imported_receivable_backfills (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  dinero_import_attempt_id INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES dinero_import_attempts(id),
  control_date TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(control_date)=10),
  control_account_no TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(account_no),
  source_raw_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(source_raw_sha256)=64),
  canonical_inventory_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(canonical_inventory_sha256)=64),
  artifact_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(artifact_sha256)=64),
  schedule_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(schedule_hash)=64),
  plan_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK(length(plan_hash)=64),
  ledger_head_hash TEXT,
  audit_head_hash TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(audit_head_hash)=64),
  ledger_balance_ore TEXT NOT NULL,
  idempotency_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(idempotency_key)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128),
  actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(actor)) BETWEEN 3 AND 160),
  principal_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(principal_kind IN ('user','service-account')),
  principal_subject_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(length(trim(principal_subject_id)) BETWEEN 1 AND 160),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE(principal_kind,principal_subject_id,idempotency_key)
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS legacy_imported_receivable_backfills_source_idx ON legacy_imported_receivable_backfills(source_raw_sha256,canonical_inventory_sha256);
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS legacy_imported_receivable_backfills_no_update BEFORE UPDATE ON legacy_imported_receivable_backfills BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'legacy imported receivable backfills are append-only'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS legacy_imported_receivable_backfills_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON legacy_imported_receivable_backfills BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'legacy imported receivable backfills are append-only'); END;
